title: Google Ads for Pet Groomers: Grooming PPC | Software Pro Digital

facts.fact: Software Pro Digital's stated reporting cadence for cost per booked groom is monthly, measured against the business's calendar rather than form fills.
facts.quote: Reported monthly against your calendar, not against form fills, so budget follows real appointments.

facts.fact: Software Pro Digital's stated policy is that salon and mobile grooming campaigns must never share a budget.
facts.quote: Different radius, different pricing, different messaging. They must never share a budget.

facts.fact: Software Pro Digital's stated process includes weekly search term work before moving budget toward the services that fill needed days.
facts.quote: Weekly search term work, then budget moved toward the services that fill the days you actually need filled.

facts.fact: Software Pro Digital's stated call tracking setup uses a duration filter so that only real conversations count as leads, with separate numbers per campaign.
facts.quote: Separate numbers per campaign and a duration filter, so only real conversations count as leads.

facts.fact: Software Pro Digital's stated negative keyword categories for grooming campaigns include job seeker searches, grooming courses, DIY and clipper queries, and cat-only terms when a business takes dogs only.
facts.quote: Job seeker searches, grooming courses, DIY and clipper queries, and cat only terms when you take dogs only.
